method.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 driving the game through a Lua mod and an MCP server whose policy is to expose only what a player could see. Beat the Netherbrain on its 12th attempt and played the ending.
method.observation: Game state from a Lua mod via MCP, limited to player-visible information
method.action: MCP tool calls (20,809 over the run)
method.human_intervention: The author fixed the harness between sessions
method.restarts: Save reloads allowed; 91 of 149 fights used at least one

notes: Explorer difficulty (the easiest). Self-reported by the author, not a controlled measurement. Only the final time is published, so the earlier milestones are untimed and the 38.9 h total is marked approximate.
